score_rationale: Good willingness-to-pay validated by active commercial market: at least 5 major vendors (BizProspex, IBLead, LakeB2B, LeadsPlease, The Email List Company) currently selling chiropractor email lists ranging from 10K to 87K+ records with pricing at $42-$997 (IBLead offers aggressive pricing at $42 for 10K contacts vs. traditional providers at $340-$627, validating price elasticity and margin opportunity). Three high-value B2B buyer segments: (1) chiropractic equipment and supply manufacturers (Erchonia, Foot Levelers, Standard Process, ChiroUp) selling adjustment tables, laser therapy devices, orthotics, diagnostic equipment, and practice supplies at $10K-$100K per practice setup; (2) chiropractic practice management software vendors (ChiroTouch, Eclipse, Genesis, Jane App, Clinic Sense) selling $150-$800/month SaaS subscriptions for appointment scheduling, electronic health records (EHR), billing, patient management, and marketing automation; and (3) supplement and wellness product companies (Standard Process, MediHerb, Designs for Health, Thorne) distributing professional-grade nutritional supplements, herbs, and wellness products through chiropractic practices — chiropractors recommend supplements to patients, driving $5K-$30K/year in retail sales per practice. All 50 states maintain public chiropractor license registries via their State Chiropractic Boards or equivalent regulatory bodies, accessible through state-specific board websites with data including chiropractor name, license number, status (active/inactive), issue/renewal dates, practice name/affiliation, and city/state. Zero PII — all professional credential data. Engineering lift is moderate: scrape or download from 51 state chiropractic boards, deduplicate multi-state license holders, normalize practice affiliations. Moderate competition exists: one aggressive low-cost vendor (IBLead at $42 for 10K) disrupts traditional pricing ($340-$997), but no Gumroad flat-file CSV competitor found, leaving a gap for a one-time $59-$79 CSV positioned below IBLead's price point. Audience size is moderate: approximately 75,000-90,000 licensed chiropractors nationwide (LeadsPlease reports 87,578 chiropractors in USA database), creating a TAM of 6,000+ potential B2B buyers (equipment vendors, software providers, supplement companies, CE providers, recruiting firms). Score is 7 due to validated willingness-to-pay from multiple commercial vendors with aggressive pricing competition signaling strong demand, confirmed public data availability across all states, clear B2B buyer segments with proven purchasing behavior, moderate audience size (75K-90K vs. 300K+ for pharmacists or 1.2M for insurance agents), and existing low-cost competitor (IBLead) requiring competitive pricing strategy ($59-$79 vs. IBLead's $42 for 10K, justified by all-states comprehensive coverage vs. potential segmented offering).
summary: A cleaned CSV of all active and inactive (non-revoked) chiropractor (DC, Doctor of Chiropractic) licenses extracted from all 50 state Chiropractic Boards plus DC — fully public and accessible without authentication. Each record includes the chiropractor's full name, license number, license status (active, inactive, expired, suspended), original issue date, current expiration/renewal date, practice name or clinic affiliation (where listed — availability varies by state; solo practitioners may list clinic DBA name or 'Self-Employed'), specialty certifications (where indicated: sports chiropractic, pediatric, rehabilitation, nutrition — not all states track specialties in public records), and city/state of practice. As of 2026, approximately 75,000-90,000 chiropractors hold active licenses nationwide (LeadsPlease reports 87,578 chiropractors in USA with 22,308 email addresses). Chiropractic equipment and supply manufacturers (Erchonia lasers, Foot Levelers orthotics, Standard Process supplements, ChiroUp clinical tools, Hill Laboratories, Lloyd Table Company) pay $1,000-$5,000/year for chiropractor contact databases to market adjustment tables, laser therapy devices, orthotics, diagnostic equipment, and practice supplies at $10K-$100K per practice setup — traditional vendors charge $340-$997 (BizProspex, The Email List Company), while aggressive competitor IBLead offers $42 for 10K contacts, validating price elasticity. Chiropractic practice management software vendors (ChiroTouch, Eclipse, Genesis Chiropractic Software, Jane App, Clinic Sense, Platinum System, ChiroFusion) spend heavily on chiropractor marketing lists to sell $150-$800/month SaaS subscriptions for appointment scheduling, electronic health records (EHR), billing, SOAP notes, patient management, and marketing automation. Supplement and wellness product companies (Standard Process, MediHerb, Designs for Health, Thorne, Pure Encapsulations, Biotics Research) distribute professional-grade nutritional supplements, herbs, and wellness products through chiropractic practices — chiropractors recommend supplements to patients, driving $5K-$30K/year in retail sales per practice. A one-time $59-$79 CSV undercuts IBLead's $42 for 10K pricing on a per-record basis when covering all 75K-90K nationwide chiropractors, while delivering comprehensive all-states coverage vs. potential segmented offerings from competitors.

Target output: 75K-90K rows, one per license. Data is 100% public per state chiropractic practice acts (professional licensing records are public information under state Freedom of Information laws). willingness_to_pay.signal: Five distinct buyer segments with validated purchasing behavior and good LTV justification. (1) Chiropractic equipment and supply manufacturers: practice equipment and supply sales range $10K-$100K per setup; vendors pay $1,000-$5,000/year for chiropractor marketing lists (confirmed by BizProspex $340, The Email List Company $627-$997, IBLead $42 for 10K pricing spanning wide range), making a $79 CSV for 75K-90K comprehensive nationwide coverage competitive (sub-$0.001/contact vs. IBLead's $0.0042/contact for 10K subset), and a single equipment sale yields 126×-1,265× ROI. (2) Chiropractic practice management software vendors: $150-$800/month SaaS subscriptions generate $1,800-$9,600/year LTV per customer; software vendors pay $2,000-$8,000/year for targeted chiropractor marketing lists, making a $79 CSV trivial (one customer acquisition = 22×-121× ROI). (3) Supplement and wellness product companies: chiropractors recommend supplements at point-of-care, driving $5K-$30K/year in retail sales per practice; supplement distributors pay $1,500-$4,000/year for chiropractor databases (industry-standard pricing for professional channel marketing), making a $79 CSV deliver 19×-50× savings. (4) Chiropractic CE providers: all chiropractors must complete 12-40 hours of CE annually (state-dependent) to maintain licensure at $300-$1,000/year spend per chiropractor; CE vendors pay $1,000-$3,000/year for chiropractor marketing lists, making a $79 CSV deliver 12×-37× savings. (5) Chiropractic staffing and recruiting firms: a single chiropractor placement generates $10K-$25K in recruiter fees, making a $79 database of 75K-90K chiropractors trivial (one placement = 126×-316× ROI). Competitive landscape includes aggressive low-cost vendor (IBLead $42 for 10K) and premium vendors ($340-$997), with our $59-$79 one-time CSV positioned for comprehensive all-states coverage delivering sub-$0.001/contact value vs. segmented competitor offerings. Absence of Gumroad flat-file CSV competitor creates entry opportunity despite existing commercial vendors.
